title: Analytic: phase-mismatched third-harmonic generation of a chi3 slab (nonlinear FDFD)
description:
Undepleted THG (em_fdfd_nonlinear, nonlinear_frequency_domain study): a y-periodic strip (4 rows of 10 nm, CPML along x) filled everywhere, PML included, with one lossless Lorentz medium (eps_inf 2, delta_eps 0.3, resonance at 300 nm: n = 1.5204 at the 1550 nm pump, 1.5661 at the 516.7 nm harmonic), so nothing reflects. An E_z line source launches the pump (A_p = 1e7 V/m) into a chi3 slab (chi3_medium, strength chi3 = 1e-19 m^2/V^2, isotropic) of length L_nl; the generated channel th = 3 p is solved once with P(3w) = (1/4) eps0 chi3 E^3 as its source. The sweep runs L_nl over 1-12 um.
Analytic (continuum): |E_3w| = (3 k0 / (8 n_3w)) chi3 A^3 |sin(dk L / 2) / (dk / 2)|, dk = 3 k0 (n_3w - n_w): the harmonic grows over a coherence length pi / dk and falls back to 0 at 2 pi / dk. References use the exact 3-point lattice form of the same sum (the 2D solve of a y-uniform strip is the 1D lattice problem): K h = 2 asin(k h / 2) per channel, |E_3w| = 9 k0^2 h^2 chi3 A^3 / (8 sin(K_3w h)) |sin(N dK / 2) / sin(dK / 2)|, dK = 3 K_w h - K_3w h, N = L / h. The lattice mismatch is ~5 % larger than the continuum one (coherence length 5.40 um instead of 5.66 um, parameters L_coh / L_coh_cont), so the continuum curve E_th_cont is drawn for comparison only (no tolerance: sweep curves compare per point, and past the coherence length its zero at 11.3 um sits beside the lattice zero at 10.8 um, ~75 % apart at L = 12 um).
Sweep tab: E_th_forward (|E_z| of the TH beyond the slab) vs L_nl with the dashed lattice curve (peak ~336 V/m near L = 5.4 um, zero near 10.8 um).
Derived values tab: E_th_forward and E_p_end (pump in the last slab cell, = A_p: undepleted, no linear step) against their references; expected ~1e-3 (CPML floor; to be confirmed by a first run).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, L_nl = 12 um, snapshot 'channel th'): |E_z| of the TH from the slab start to 1 um past its end vs the exact lattice profile (forward growth sin(dK (n + 1) / 2) / sin(dK / 2) plus the small backward-generated part, which leaves a ~1.5 % ripple).

parameters.name: lam_r
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the lossless Lorentz resonance

parameters.name: chi3_val
parameters.description: chi3 of the slab [m^2/V^2] (chi_xxxx; E_z only sees chi_zzzz = chi3)

parameters.name: A_p
parameters.description: pump amplitude [V/m] the line source launches into the medium

parameters.name: L_nl
parameters.description: chi3 slab length (swept 1-12 um; whole cells)

parameters.name: x_p_end
parameters.description: pump probe: centre of the last slab cell

parameters.name: x_fwd
parameters.description: forward TH probe (cell centre, 100 cells past the slab)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length (CPML on both x faces, outside the window)

parameters.name: K_p
parameters.description: lattice phase per cell of the pump wave

parameters.name: K_th
parameters.description: lattice phase per cell of the TH wave

parameters.name: dK
parameters.description: lattice phase mismatch per cell (forward generation, -5.81e-3)

parameters.name: sK
parameters.description: lattice phase sum per cell (backward generation)

parameters.name: C_th
parameters.description: TH generated per slab cell [V/m]: h^2 / (2 sin K_th) (3 k0)^2 (chi3 / 4) A^3

analytic_curves.name: th_profile
analytic_curves.expression: C_th*sqrt((sin(dK*(min((x - x_nl)/dx_cell - 0.5, N_nl - 1) + 1)/2)/sin(dK/2))**2 + (sin(sK*max(N_nl - 0.5 - (x - x_nl)/dx_cell, 0)/2)/sin(sK/2))**2 + 2*(sin(dK*(min((x - x_nl)/dx_cell - 0.5, N_nl - 1) + 1)/2)/sin(dK/2))*(sin(sK*max(N_nl - 0.5 - (x - x_nl)/dx_cell, 0)/2)/sin(sK/2))*cos(sK*N_nl/2 - K_th*((x - x_nl)/dx_cell - 0.5)))
